data.message: I keep my 18-ton commitment. The 10-ton norm does guarantee 500 next month; 18 risks lower future income. Fisher03/12: your offers remain conditional—would you choose 18 even if others choose 10? Fisher07/23: please clarify your exact catch and conditions. Each 10-ton proposer: would you opt into 18 for $8,000 extra now if fulfilled? No veto required.
